mapper.insert: insert into sci_jiaocairuanzhu_member (jiaocai_id, member_id, member_name, ranking, research_score, is_chief_editor, is_associate_editor, is_member) values (#{jiaocaiId}, #{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{ranking}, #{researchScore}, #{isChiefEditor}, #{isAssociateEditor}, #{isMember})
mapper.select: select id, jiaocai_id as jiaocaiId, member_id as memberId, member_name as memberName, ranking, research_score as researchScore, is_chief_editor as isChiefEditor, is_associate_editor as isAssociateEditor, is_member as isMember from sci_jiaocairuanzhu_member where jiaocai_id = #{jiaocaiId} order by cast(ranking as unsigned) asc
